title: 第453章 顺利出院第452章 妙手回春啊大夫
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
周心蓝深吸口气就说道：“问题是你是如何办到的？你是怎么直接灭杀李女士子宫里的恶性肿瘤，又是怎么将其逼出体外的？我刚才一直都在现场看着，你仅仅只是按摩推拿李女士的小腹而已，并没有做别的事情。”
“所以说这就是你与我之间的差距，我就算是当着你的面给病人治疗，你也看不懂我的手段。就好像两个绝世高手切磋武艺，像你这样的菜鸟就算是全程在旁观看，也什么都看不明白。”赵大柱说道。
听到这话，周心蓝简直都要被气死了。
可她又觉得赵大柱说的话很有道理，甚至就连他做出的比喻也是那么的生动形象，而且通俗易懂。
此时此刻，周心蓝完全不知道该怎么办了，她感觉自己学了好多年的医术，全都白学了。
李婉容终于按捺不住了，问道：“周主任，王院长，也就是说我的子宫癌已经彻底康复了，我的病已经全都被赵神医治好了对吧？”
“对，是这样的。”周心蓝不得不点头。
“那我是不是就可以出院了？”李婉容急切的问。
周心蓝这次没有回答，而是看向王远纪。
王远纪沉吟片刻说道：“赵大爷的手段，我自然是相信的，不过我还是建议李女士再住院一段时间，观察观察。毕竟你现在才刚刚好，就这么着急的出院，万一要是发生什么意外……”
“会有意外发生吗？”李婉容问道，她询问的对象自然是赵大柱。
“不会有什么意外，你确实已经康复了，能有个锤子意外。当然如果你说的意外是出门被车撞，那这样的意外确实是有可能发生的，不过这就和你的身体病情毫无关系了。”赵大柱笑道。
“那就不住院了，住院一天就要好几百块钱，一周下来就是大几千，这负担实在是太重了，而且我家里也不是很有钱……”李婉容不大好意思的说道。
“那行吧，我这就安排人给你办理出院手续。”王远纪说道。
半个多小时以后，董乐乐和李婉容就手牵手的跟在赵大柱的身后从医院里出来了。
呼吸着外面的新鲜空气，沐浴着绯红的阳光，李婉容竟有种重活一回的错觉。
而且在阳光的照耀下，李婉容感到浑身都暖洋洋的，好像身体重新焕发活力。
“从医院里出来的感觉怎么样？”赵大柱问道。
李婉容感激的说道：“感觉非常好，就好像重新活过来了一样，这都是赵神医你的功劳，真的太谢谢你了。”
“别叫我赵神医了，叫我赵大爷就行。”赵大柱摆摆手笑呵呵的说道。

顿了顿，赵大柱又说道：“你要感谢就感谢董乐乐吧，我是看在她的面子上才专门来这里给你治疗的。”
听到赵大柱这么说，李婉容就十分感动的看向董乐乐。
而董乐乐小脸通红，两只手捏着裙子扭扭捏捏的，好像小手手都无处安放了。
“我还有事，先走一步，如果你们又遇到什么麻烦就尽管来找我，不用跟我客气，我一定不会袖手旁观。”赵大柱铿锵有力的说道。
content_en:
Zhou Xinlan took a deep breath and said: "The question is how did you do it? How did you directly kill the malignant tumor in Ms. Li's uterus, and how did you force it out of the body? I was watching the scene just now. You just massaged Ms. Li's lower abdomen and did nothing else."
"So this is the gap between you and me. Even if I treat a patient in front of you, you can't understand my methods. It's like two peerless masters competing in martial arts. A rookie like you can't understand anything even if he watches the whole process." Zhao Dazhu said.
Hearing this, Zhou Xinlan was almost furious to death.
But she also felt that what Zhao Dazhu said was very reasonable, and even the metaphors he made were so vivid and easy to understand.
At this moment, Zhou Xinlan didn't know what to do at all. She felt that all the medical skills she had learned for many years were in vain.
Li Wanrong finally couldn't hold it any longer and asked, "Director Zhou, Dean Wang, that means I have completely recovered from uterine cancer and all my illnesses have been cured by Dr. Zhao, right?"
"Yes, that's true." Zhou Xinlan had to nod.
"Then can I be discharged from the hospital?" Li Wanrong asked eagerly.
Zhou Xinlan did not answer this time, but looked at Wang Yuanji.
Wang Yuanji pondered for a moment and said: "I naturally believe in Uncle Zhao's methods, but I still suggest that Ms. Li stay in the hospital for a while for observation. After all, you are just fine now, and you are so anxious to be discharged from the hospital, in case something unexpected happens..."
"Will there be an accident?" Li Wanrong asked, and the person she asked was naturally Zhao Dazhu.
"There won't be any accidents. You have indeed recovered. You can have a hammer accident. Of course, if the accident you are talking about is being hit by a car when you go out, then such an accident is indeed possible, but it has nothing to do with your physical condition." Zhao Dazhu said with a smile.
"Then we won't be hospitalized. Hospitalization costs several hundred yuan a day, and several thousand yuan a week. This burden is really too heavy, and my family is not very rich..." Li Wanrong said sheepishly.
"Okay, I'll arrange for someone to go through the discharge procedures for you." Wang Yuanji said.
More than half an hour later, Dong Lele and Li Wanrong came out of the hospital hand in hand, following Zhao Dazhu.
Breathing the fresh air outside and bathing in the crimson sunshine, Li Wanrong actually had the illusion of living her life again.
And under the sunshine, Li Wanrong felt warm all over, as if her body was rejuvenated.
"How do you feel after coming out of the hospital?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
Li Wanrong said gratefully: "I feel very good, as if I have come back to life again. This is all due to you, Dr. Zhao. Thank you very much."
"Don't call me Divine Doctor Zhao. Just call me Uncle Zhao." Zhao Dazhu waved his hands and said with a smile.
After a pause, Zhao Dazhu said again: "If you want to thank, just thank Dong Lele. I came here specifically to treat you for her sake."
Hearing what Zhao Dazhu said, Li Wanrong looked at Dong Lele with great emotion.
Dong Lele's face was red, and she was holding her skirt with both hands, as if she had nowhere to put her little hands.
"I still have something to do. Let's take a step first. If you encounter any trouble again, just come to me. Don't be polite to me. I will not stand idly by." Zhao Dazhu said sonorously.
